'''2010 Malastare Regionals Eric White LS Hoth: Echo Command Center''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Eric White]] at [[2010 Malastare Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Deck name:''' Cotton Picking
* '''Username:''' The Digital Jawa
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
